title: how much VRAM do you need to comfortably run 13B models
body:
been looking into getting a dedicated GPU for local models, and some people say you can run 13B models with 8GB VRAM, others say you need 16GB minimum.

what's your actual experience with this? can you actually run the models on 8GB or will it be annoyingly slow?

submitted by /u/close_Meal6005
